description: Turn a company name into the token that addresses its Ashby job board, and report every form that answered. search_jobs does this on its own, so call this when a name returns nothing and you want to see the spellings that were tried.

name.description: A company name, or an Ashby board token you already know.

name: resolve_board

board.description: The token that answered. Ashby ignores case and echoes the spelling it was given, so this is no canonical spelling.

publishes.description: False when the board exists and publishes nothing.

tried.description: The forms actually sent, in order.

title: Resolve company names to Ashby boards
